title: Thanksgiving Weekend Family Activities and Days Out
description: Family ideas for Thanksgiving weekend in the US: parades, turkey trots, free museums, national park walks, holiday lights and beating the crowds.
h1: Thanksgiving weekend: family activities and days out
intro: Thanksgiving falls on Thursday 26 November in 2026, giving many families a long weekend. Here are ways to get out of the house between the leftovers.

image.alt: A child in yellow wellies walking through autumn leaves

cardText: Parades, turkey trots, museums and lights for the long weekend.

blocks.title: Scout’s long-weekend tip
blocks.text: Skip the Black Friday malls and head outdoors. Parks and trails are often quiet while everyone else is shopping.
points: Many holiday light shows open this weekend

sections.html:
• Parades: many cities hold Thanksgiving parades. Arrive early for a good spot, or watch on TV.
  • Turkey trots: family-friendly fun runs and walks on Thanksgiving morning, often raising money for charity.

• Get outdoors: a walk in a state or national park.
  • Museums: the Smithsonian is free. See more free US days out.
  • Holiday lights and skating rinks often open around now.
  • Theme parks begin their holiday seasons. See Disney.
Friday and Saturday are busy at attractions, so go early or pick outdoor plans. Use the adventure finder for US ideas.

faqs.a: Thanksgiving in the US is on Thursday 26 November 2026.
